# anomaly_schedule_coverage (Data Source)

Standing coverage report across all schedules. Only schedules with a gap, a participant that no longer exists, or that are disabled are listed at all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anomaly_schedule_coverage" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `checked_at` (String)
- `degraded_attached` (Number) Degraded schedules an escalation chain actually pages through.
- `id` (String) Always set to "schedule_coverage".
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `schedules_degraded` (Number)
- `schedules_total` (Number) Counted after team scoping, like items.
- `window_days` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `acknowledged` (Boolean) Every referencing step set allow_uncovered, i.e. the gap is an accepted decision rather than an oversight.
- `attached_to` (Attributes List) Escalation chains that page through this schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--attached_to))
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `first_gap` (Attributes) Earliest gap in the window; null when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--first_gap))
- `gap_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `schedule_id` (String)
- `unknown_users` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--attached_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.attached_to`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--items--first_gap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.first_gap`

Read-Only:

- `duration_seconds` (Number)
- `end` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `start` (String)
- `user_ids` (List of String)
